description: Prometheus + node-exporter dashboard for viewing disk performance, utilization and saturation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, device, mount_path) (rate(read_io_latency_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])))
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by(le, device, mount_path) (rate(read_io_latency_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(le, device, mount_path) (rate(write_io_latency_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])))
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum by(le, device, mount_path) (rate(write_io_latency_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])))
rate(read_bytes_total{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval]) / rate(read_ops_total{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])
rate(write_bytes_total{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval]) / rate(write_ops_total{instance=~"$Node", device!="sr0", device=~"$Disk"}[$RateInterval])
